metadata.milestone: Phase 2 - Authentic ISL Data Acquisition & Signing Dataset Development
metadata.governance_rule: Strict non-fabrication. Zero mock video links. All candidate signs tagged NEEDS_REVIEW, EXPLANATION_REQUIRED, or UNSUPPORTED until verified by certified Deaf native signers or RCI-licensed interpreters.

inventory.subject: Database Management Systems

phonology.dominant_hand: Right hand active; left hand passive base
phonology.handshape: Flat open B-handshape (base) with curved claw/C-handshape descending in stacked layers
phonology.movement: Downward repetitive stacking motions representing structured table records
phonology.location: Neutral signing space directly in front of chest
phonology.non_manual_markers: Neutral brow, mouth movement subtle voicing of 'Data'

authoritative_reference.institution: ISLRTC (Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre)
authoritative_reference.license: Government Open Data License (GODL-India) / Educational Reference

mocap_3d_availability.notes: No 54-keypoint full-body mocap exists. Avatar strictly suppressed to neutral rest posture.

data_gaps: High-definition studio re-recording at 60fps needed for fine finger clarity
Missing dual-perspective (side-view) recording for 3D depth extraction
Formal sign-off required from certified Deaf STEM educator
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Deaf engineering educators utilize two-handed stacking classifier followed by fingerspelled 'D-B'.

inventory.subject: Operating Systems

phonology.dominant_hand: Two-handed symmetrical sign
phonology.handshape: C-handshapes opening into flat O, transitioning to dual steering/control movement
phonology.movement: Synchronous forward and circular control manipulation
phonology.location: Mid-chest level in primary signing zone
phonology.orientation: Palms facing each other then rotating downwards
phonology.non_manual_markers: Focused gaze directed at signing space

data_gaps: Regional dialect variations between Northern (Delhi/ISLRTC) and Southern (Chennai) Deaf communities
Requires licensing clearance for commercial deployment beyond academic prototyping
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Commonly fingerspelled 'O-S' accompanied by pointing to system architecture diagram.

inventory.subject: Computer Networks

phonology.dominant_hand: Two-handed bilateral
phonology.handshape: 5-spread hands with curved fingers intertwining at fingertips (mesh topology)
phonology.movement: Fingers interlock repeatedly across spatial nodes
phonology.non_manual_markers: Slight head nod indicating mutual linkage

authoritative_reference.resource_name: Dictionary of Indian Sign Language (3rd Edition)

data_gaps: Need clarification on whether mesh vs bus vs star topology should have distinct classifier modulations
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Dynamic classifier tracing packets travelling along imaginary cables between laptops.

inventory.subject: Operating Systems

phonology.dominant_hand: Both fists (S-handshape) colliding heads-on and freezing rigidly
phonology.movement: Sharp forward collision followed by zero movement, depicting locked mutual wait
phonology.non_manual_markers: Tense facial expression, closed tight lips indicating complete immobility

authoritative_reference.institution: National Institute of Speech and Hearing (NISH) / Deaf Technical Educators

data_gaps: Term is not codified in any official Indian Sign Language dictionary
Risk of linguistic confusion with general English 'traffic jam' or physical lock
Requires convening an expert panel of Deaf software engineers to establish formal standardized gloss
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Educators draw resource allocation graphs (circular wait) on whiteboard with two-handed fingerspelling 'D-E-A-D-L-O-C-K'.

Lexicon creation workshop needed with Deaf computer science graduates

inventory.subject: Circuit Theory & Analysis

inventory.subject: Signals & Systems

phonology.dominant_hand: Index finger waving up and down oscillating across horizontal line
phonology.movement: Rapid sinusoidal wave motion moving laterally from left to right
phonology.location: Chest level, sweeping 30cm across neutral zone
phonology.non_manual_markers: Quick repeated eye blinks matching frequency oscillation

video_availability.validation_note: Acquired from GODL-India open dataset mirror; awaiting primary ISLRTC source confirmation and certified Deaf master panel review before full authentication.

data_gaps: Distinguishing high frequency (rapid tight sine waves) from low frequency (broad gentle waves)
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Sinusoidal hand tracing with fingerspelled 'H-Z' (Hertz).

inventory.subject: Communication Systems

phonology.dominant_hand: Both hands trace separate waves, then dominant wave alters amplitude/frequency of base wave
phonology.handshape: Flat open hands morphing into wavy patterns
phonology.movement: Superposition of high-frequency carrier with low-frequency audio envelope
phonology.non_manual_markers: Concentrated brow furrow during mixing

data_gaps: Complex abstract concept; cannot be rendered as a single atomic word
Must support Amplitude Modulation (AM), Frequency Modulation (FM), and Phase Modulation (PM) variants
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Pedagogical multi-sign classifier explanation: Dual-hand spatial demonstration combining high-frequency carrier sinusoidal wave with low-frequency information signal to illustrate amplitude/frequency/phase variation, accompanied by fingerspelling M-O-D-U-L-A-T-I-O-N and visual waveform diagrams.

inventory.subject: Electronic Devices & Circuits

phonology.dominant_hand: Right index finger points forward through a vertical barrier formed by left flat palm; left hand blocks backward motion
phonology.movement: Passes easily in forward direction; strikes left palm on return and bounces back
phonology.orientation: Left palm facing signer; right finger moving toward screen then blocked returning
phonology.non_manual_markers: Nod on pass, head shake on block

data_gaps: Need formal validation by RCI certified interpreter to verify non-manual marking accuracy
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Schematic triangle-and-line drawn in air followed by one-way valve gesture.

inventory.subject: Microprocessors & Microcontrollers

phonology.dominant_hand: Thumb and index finger pinch into small rectangular chip boundary, then two hands outline integrated box
phonology.movement: Small precise pinch held steady, then encompassing circular gesture
phonology.non_manual_markers: Squinting eyes indicating microscopic scale

authoritative_reference.institution: National Institute of Speech and Hearing (NISH)

data_gaps: No standard pan-India sign exists; commonly confused with Microprocessor (CPU)
Requires dedicated lexicon workshop with Deaf hardware engineers
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Fingerspell 'M-C-U' followed by pointing to physical Arduino/STM32 development board.

inventory.subject: Engineering Mechanics

phonology.dominant_hand: Both open B-palms held forward with muscular tension
phonology.movement: Strong forward pushing motion accompanied by isometric tension in shoulders
phonology.orientation: Palms facing directly outward away from body
phonology.non_manual_markers: Clenched jaw, tight eye posture reflecting physical effort

authoritative_reference.resource_name: Dictionary of Indian Sign Language (3rd Edition - Science)

data_gaps: Differentiating tensile force (pulling) vs compressive force (pushing) vs shear force in sign space
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Vector arrow in air + push gesture.

inventory.subject: Kinematics of Machinery

phonology.dominant_hand: Index finger extended, slices swiftly through air along a fixed linear vector angle
phonology.movement: Rapid ballistic linear sweep from left hip toward top right
phonology.location: Lower torso to upper neutral boundary
phonology.non_manual_markers: Puffed cheeks releasing air 'puh' signifying sudden displacement

data_gaps: Clarifying scalar speed (speedometer gesture) vs vector velocity (spatial trajectory)
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Speed sign followed by distinct arrow directional point.

inventory.subject: Engineering Mechanics

phonology.dominant_hand: Dominant C-handshape grips non-dominant index finger (shaft) and twists forcefully around its axis
phonology.movement: Rotational twisting torque motion with wrist flexion
phonology.location: Directly in front of solar plexus
phonology.orientation: Left finger vertical; right hand gripping from side
phonology.non_manual_markers: Tight brow furrow reflecting mechanical resistance

video_availability.validation_note: Acquired from GODL-India open dataset mirror; awaiting primary ISLRTC source confirmation and certified Deaf master panel review before full authentication.

data_gaps: Needs validation for clockwise vs counter-clockwise moment representation
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Wrench twisting gesture around imaginary bolt.

inventory.subject: Fluid Mechanics

phonology.dominant_hand: Two flat palms rubbing against each other with shuddering, jerky motion representing contact drag
phonology.movement: Reciprocating shear motion with stuttered resistance
phonology.orientation: Right palm facing left; left palm facing right
phonology.non_manual_markers: Lips drawn back over teeth, showing friction resistance

data_gaps: Distinguishing static friction vs kinetic friction in linguistic morphology
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Palm rubbing + heat generation mime.

inventory.subject: Thermodynamics

phonology.dominant_hand: Two neat parallel fists suddenly opening into chaotic floating 5-claw fingers dispersing in all directions
phonology.movement: Organized structure dissolving into random outward expansion
phonology.location: Expanding across entire chest signing space
phonology.orientation: Palms turning from parallel facing to chaotic outward directions
phonology.non_manual_markers: Wide eyes, open mouth indicating entropy increase

data_gaps: Highly abstract thermodynamic quantity; cannot be rendered as a single lexical gloss
Risk of misconception as mere 'messiness' rather than microstates multiplicity
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Animated particle simulation shown side-by-side with localized dispersion classifier.

inventory.subject: Finite Element Analysis

phonology.dominant_hand: Two hands outline 3D mechanical part, then fingers create discrete grid mesh, followed by computer calculate sign
phonology.handshape: Flat palms to intersecting grid fingers
phonology.movement: Outlining then cross-hatching
phonology.non_manual_markers: Intense analytical concentration

data_gaps: Completely uncodified in Indian Sign Language
Must be flagged UNSUPPORTED in translation pipeline to prevent synthetic ungrammatical output
inventory.pedagogical_alternative: Multi-step conceptual decomposition: 1. Continuous structural domain -> 2. Mesh discretization (finite elements) -> 3. Node-element stiffness matrix formulation -> 4. Numerical solution of stress-strain tensors and displacement distribution. Accompanied by two-handed fingerspelling F-E-A and spatial classifier mesh representation.

phonology.handshape: Right forearm flat horizontal; left and right fists as pillars
phonology.movement: Positioning horizontal member firmly onto supports with downward settling pressure
phonology.non_manual_markers: Firm neutral gaze

authoritative_reference.resource_name: Vocational and Construction Trades ISL Glossary
